theme.description: A dark tavern theme combining moody, cinematic depth with organic, worn textures like wood and parchment. This fits the 'Full medieval / dark tavern' mobile game aesthetic.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-aged_gold drop-shadow-md

layout_and_spacing.container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen relative overflow-hidden bg-background_primary
layout_and_spacing.strategy: Mobile-first responsive. Use vertical stacks and generous padding (p-6, p-8) for breathing room. Elements should float slightly using drop shadows.

buttons.primary: w-full bg-surface_wood border-2 border-accent_aged_gold text-accent_aged_gold hover:bg-accent_aged_gold hover:text-surface_wood font-bold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-md py-4 shadow-[0_4px_14px_rgba(212,175,55,0.2)] transition-all
buttons.secondary: w-full bg-transparent border border-text_secondary text-text_secondary hover:bg-white/10 rounded-md py-3 transition-all
buttons.action_roll: bg-accent_candlelight text-background_primary border-2 border-accent_candlelight hover:bg-accent_candlelight/80 hover:scale-105 rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-black shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,158,61,0.4)] transition-all

cards.tavern_card: relative bg-surface_wood border border-accent_aged_gold/50 rounded-lg shadow-xl p-4 overflow-hidden
cards.parchment_card: relative bg-surface_parchment text-text_on_parchment border-2 border-surface_parchment_dark rounded-sm shadow-md p-6 font-serif

icons.usage: Use Shield for scores, Swords for battles/online, Crown for leaderboards, Scroll for rules, Coins for shop.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Buttons lift slightly (-translate-y-1) with an intensified gold drop-shadow.
motion_and_interactions.active_states: Buttons scale down (scale-95) to simulate a physical press.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Smooth transitions on all color and transform changes (duration-200 ease-in-out).

screens.Home: Hero section with tavern background (dimmed overlay), prominent stylized game title, and a vertical stack of primary buttons navigating to core features.
screens.Game: Top area: Shield-shaped scoreboards for players. Middle area: Wooden 'table' for dice. Bottom area: Action buttons ('Cast the Bones', 'Hoard Gold'). Cursed state triggers crimson UI flashes.
screens.Rules: Presented inside a 'parchment_card' layout simulating a scroll. Text is rich and deeply indented.
screens.LocalSetup: Form placed on a wood-styled container. Inputs styled like recessed carvings or leather strips.
screens.OnlineLobby: List of active games in a 'tavern board' style list. Aged gold accents.
screens.Leaderboard: Rows of high scores. Top 3 rows highlighted with gold, silver, bronze respectively, and crown icons.
screens.DiceShop: Grid displaying 5 unlockable dice colorways with their purchase buttons (styled with coin icons).
screens.WinnerModal: Heavy glassmorphism/dark backdrop blur modal overlaying the game. Large victory text in Cinzel/Gold.

tavern_bg.description: Candlelit medieval tavern interior. Apply dark overlay (bg-black/70) for text readability.

parchment_texture.description: Old parchment texture to use as a background or blend-mode overlay for cards and rules.

tavern_sign.description: Wooden tavern sign to use in the Dice Shop or Lobby as an accent graphic.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Replace all text explicitly mentioned in terminology_renames. Do not use 'Bank Points' or 'Roll Dice' anywhere.
CRITICAL: Set up Tailwind CSS configuration to include the custom colors listed under 'colors'.
CRITICAL: Since it is a mobile_web_app, force a mobile view layout: all major wrapper divs should have 'w-full max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen'. Do not make it stretch across desktop monitors.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive elements, e.g., data-testid='cast-the-bones-button'.
Integrate Google Fonts for 'Cinzel' (headings) and 'Lora' or 'Merriweather' (body) via index.css or index.html.
For the dice rolling visual, you can use Lucide dice icons (Dice1 to Dice6) or custom SVGs colored appropriately for the 5 shop colorways.
